standing: THE FINAL LATENT ATTEMPT. A stopping rule governs what follows either outcome.
HYPOTHESIS: When payoff-resolved states contain substantial specialist action contrast, presenting BOTH specialist targets at the SAME state under different latent IDs forces a shared K=2 policy to encode specialist identity, rather than solving rehearsal with a latent-independent state-conditioned mapping.

WHY_V1_FAILED_MECHANISTICALLY.reading: The wrong latent matched each teacher within ~2 points of the right one. V1 reproduced 1.3% of the contrast present in its own supervision targets. The latents never specialised -- on FIT or CALIB.
WHY_V1_FAILED_MECHANISTICALLY.cause: V1 trained only ONE latent per resolved state: A-preferred anchored (s,z0)->pi_A while z1 was unconstrained on that same state. The shared actor could satisfy the entire objective with s -> teacher-like action and ignore z.
WHY_V1_FAILED_MECHANISTICALLY.note: This is a correction to the earlier MEMORIZATION_GENERALIZATION fork, which compared each latent only against its OWN teacher and therefore could not distinguish 'specialised then failed to transfer' from 'never specialised'.

FEASIBILITY_ESTABLISHED_BEFORE_THIS_SPEC.margin_note: Clears the bar by 2.25 points. Real but not comfortable; stated as such.
FEASIBILITY_ESTABLISHED_BEFORE_THIS_SPEC.why_it_matters: Paired supervision only forces z to matter where the teachers actually disagree. Two-thirds of resolved states carry at least one contradictory head, so a z-independent policy provably cannot satisfy both targets there.

resolved_state_delta_nonzero.applies: on EVERY resolved state, REGARDLESS of which teacher is locally preferred

THE_TREATMENT.tied_state_delta_zero: NO paired specialist rehearsal. Unchanged from V1.
THE_TREATMENT.no_explicit_JSD_loss: Deliberately absent. The teachers already supply legitimate divergence; we do not manufacture additional disagreement. The latents should differ exactly where and how the proven specialists differ.

THE_ORACLE_GATE_IS_REINTERPRETED.V1_reading: Delta<0 means pi_A is better here, so only reinforce z0. (winner-only gate)
THE_ORACLE_GATE_IS_REINTERPRETED.OG_PSP_reading: Delta!=0 means specialist identity MATTERS here, so supervise both. (strategic-relevance gate)
THE_ORACLE_GATE_IS_REINTERPRETED.what_is_preserved: Ties still receive zero rehearsal -- the payoff evidence did not establish that strategic choice mattered there.
THE_ORACLE_GATE_IS_REINTERPRETED.what_is_fixed: The identifiability hole. Both latents are now constrained on the same state.

THE_DELIBERATE_DEPARTURE_STATED_PLAINLY.what: On an A-preferred state, z1 is trained toward pi_B -- the demonstrably WORSE action at that state by the payoff evidence.
THE_DELIBERATE_DEPARTURE_STATED_PLAINLY.why_this_is_not_an_error: The objective is no longer 'make every latent good on every resolved state'. It is 'make z0 faithfully represent specialist A and z1 faithfully represent specialist B, on states where payoff evidence says the distinction matters'. Some locally suboptimal behaviour is constitutive of being a specialist.
THE_DELIBERATE_DEPARTURE_STATED_PLAINLY.and_it_is_required_by_the_target: The frozen EVAL gate wants V(z0,A)>V(z1,A) AND V(z1,B)>V(z0,B). For that crossover to exist, z1 must retain B-like behaviour even in some A-favouring situations. If both latents always converge to whichever teacher is locally optimal, they collapse into the same adaptive generalist -- which is precisely what V1 produced.
THE_DELIBERATE_DEPARTURE_STATED_PLAINLY.cost_acknowledged: This trades away part of V1's 'only reinforce where the evidence supports it' principle. Recorded as a chosen trade, not a side effect.

TWO_AXES_CHANGE_STATED_PROSPECTIVELY.axis_1: paired specialist supervision instead of one-sided supervision
TWO_AXES_CHANGE_STATED_PROSPECTIVELY.axis_2: much larger and more diverse rehearsal bank
TWO_AXES_CHANGE_STATED_PROSPECTIVELY.consequence: If OG-PSP succeeds we CANNOT attribute the improvement to either axis alone. This is deliberately not a single-axis ablation.
TWO_AXES_CHANGE_STATED_PROSPECTIVELY.why_accepted: This is the final latent attempt under a stopping rule. Maximising the chance of testing the CORRECT mechanism is worth more than a clean ablation of a lever the evidence has already shown is not the binding constraint.

HELD_FIXED_FROM_V1: fresh step-0 initialisation, no checkpoint or optimizer reuse
z0 rollout -> Pole A (OP6 + SDS2_A_payoff_INIT_3 overlay); z1 -> Pole B (OP7)
FIXED_OPPONENT, opponent_randomize False, persistent latent-to-pole assignment
all runtime auditors active and FAIL-CLOSED

LOSS_SCALE_MUST_NOT_SILENTLY_DOUBLE.issue: Paired supervision produces TWO targets per sampled state instead of one. With an unchanged batch size of 64 states that is 128 (state, latent) pairs, so a summed loss would roughly double the rehearsal gradient relative to V1 and confound the mechanism change with a strength change.
LOSS_SCALE_MUST_NOT_SILENTLY_DOUBLE.rule: The rehearsal loss is the MEAN over all (state, latent) pairs in the batch. Per-example gradient scale therefore matches V1 and lambda keeps its meaning.
LOSS_SCALE_MUST_NOT_SILENTLY_DOUBLE.batch: 64 STATES -> 128 pairs, averaged. State diversity per step is preserved.

BANK.new_collection_status: in progress at spec-freeze time; allowed to finish
BANK.eligibility: Delta != 0 only; ties loaded but never sampled so zero-pressure stays MEASURED
BANK.sampling: uniform without replacement over eligible states; no weighting, no adaptive or curriculum sampling, no hard-example mining
BANK.expected_replay_reduction: V1 replayed 428 states 188.86x; a >=1500-state bank at the same budget cuts replay roughly 3.5x

GATES.statistic: paired percentile bootstrap over seed-level outcomes, 20000 samples, alpha 0.05
GATES.provenance: unchanged from the V1 EVAL spec, itself adopted unchanged from eval_exp2_k2_terminal.py
GATES.rho_o_max_kappa: NOT APPLICABLE BY DESIGN -- no test-time abstention mechanism

retention.status: REPORTED FOR CONTEXT ONLY, never a gate
retention.watch: Paired supervision trains each latent toward its specialist even where that specialist is locally worse, so retention may fall below V1's 0.9816. A large drop would be scientifically interesting and must be reported, but it does not gate and must not be promoted into one after the fact.

STOPPING_RULE.fail: Freeze as a valid negative result. No post-hoc gate changes, no extra seeds, no checkpoint shopping, no further latent tweak. Pivot to the SAPPO-centred ICRA paper with the compression-limit finding.

PROHIBITED: training paired targets on tied states
weighting or filtering the bank by |Delta|
summing rather than averaging the paired loss
reusing the spent V1 EVAL block
